text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Why did you
suggest running in this race?"
choice_data_list: Because I thought it was necessary.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I don't get it.
That's just your wild imagination talking.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why...
did I go ahead and say yes too?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You've gotta be kidding!?
Daiwa Scarlet is entering the Derby too!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I was certain she had chosen
the Tiara route—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, why are you even here?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Vodoo-san.
You've decided to take on the Derby this time, but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure there were all kinds of reactions from those around her.
From voices anticipating her new challenge, to...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Right down to the voices calling it 'half-hearted,' huh.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Had you already caught wind of that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Some of them even told me directly to my face.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like “It makes no sense,”
or “Did she run away from the Tiara showdown?”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“Giving up on the Derby just because of that,
though? That'd just be lame.”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What got me to enroll in Tracen Academy
was watching the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Every single one of them was fired up, refusing to give an inch... Watching them gave me chills.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...It was so cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to be like them back then.
I want someone to look at me and think I'm cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A brand of "coolness" only I can show.
Right here, in this Derby.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? That is a very fine goal.
However, if that's the case, I have one major question.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If you planned to run in the Derby from the start,
why did you enter the Oka Sho instead of the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...There was someone who caught my attention just a little.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to clash with her and find out.
That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Why am I running away from her, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I look so pathetic, don't I?
This isn't like the number one Umamusume at all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to beat her and become number one.
...There's no other option.
